description: Print page numbers on a PDF using a format template with {n} (page number) and {total} (page count), e.g. "Page {n} of {total}". Default is "{n} / {total}" at bottom-center, 10 pt. Numbers sit upright for any page size or rotation. Standard Helvetica only (WinAnsi characters). Page i always shows start+i-1 even when pages selects only some pages. Returns the result inline as an application/pdf resource; the source is never modified.

margin.description: Distance in points from the page edge, default 24

pages.description: 1-based page spec such as "1-3,5"; default all pages

password.description: Password to open the input, only needed for a user-password PDF (owner-locked files with an empty user password open without it).

pdf_path.description: PDF source: an https:// URL or a data:application/pdf;base64,… URI (this hosted server cannot read local file paths).

name: pdf_page_numbers

bytes.description: Size of the produced PDF in bytes

resource_uri.description: pdfops:// uri of the inline application/pdf resource

title: Add page numbers to PDF
